candidates.change_summary: Assigns betLimit to amount + 1 instead of amount, so AdjustBetAmounts sets a different betLimit.
Relaxed the onlyOwner modifier to check msg.sender == owner OR msg.sender == whale, allowing whale to call AdjustBetAmounts and thus potentially change betLimit via a different caller's behavior.
Replace assignment to difficulty with assignment to difficulty plus the provided amount (increments rather than sets).
Replace assignment to difficulty with assignment to amount modulo a nonzero value to potentially change stored value (introduces modulo operation).
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the owner check) so AdjustDifficulty can be called by anyone, altering who can change difficulty.
